svg.text: What a correctly rounded function costs the tile
Instructions in the tile's own program for one correctly rounded result, per format. Exp and log families (M1): the
most any rounding attribute needs. Sin, cos and tan (M2): the same at every attribute. Below: the three trigonometric
functions split into range reduction, the series and the finish.
where sin, cos and tan spend their instructions
